patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with a consistent dark background are used throughout the page, creating a unified visual experience, punctuated by a single distinct blue section.
A strong contrast between oversized, elegant serif display headings and clean, legible sans-serif body text creates a sophisticated yet modern typographic hierarchy.
The primary color scheme is a dark charcoal background with light grey text, accented by a vibrant orange/red for calls to action and key highlights.
Sections reveal with a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect as the user scrolls, while a large, semi-transparent 'Ethos' text element appears and parallaxes in the background of lower sections.
A distinctive 'LIVE TVC' section features a prominent, animating circular counter, drawing attention to real-time data or activity.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion system, use a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate staggered fade-in and slide-up animations for content sections as they enter the viewport. Implement a sticky header that remains fixed at the top. The hero background should be a looping video or complex CSS animation of clouds. The 'LIVE TVC' section requires a numerical counter animation. The large background text elements should use a combination of opacity changes and subtle parallaxing based on scroll depth.

Achieve the full-bleed section layout using CSS grid or flexbox with content constrained to a maximum width. Apply subtle background textures (like scanlines or noise) to dark sections for visual depth. Use a dark overlay on the hero video for text contrast. Implement a clean, minimal navigation that sticks to the top of the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif display headings (~5-6x body text) are paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body and UI elements, creating a dramatic yet clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and between major sections, providing clear visual separation, while content within sections maintains a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of classic, elegant serif typography with a dark, modern, and subtly glitchy aesthetic creates a unique brand identity. The use of large, semi-transparent background text elements that parallax and fade in/out adds significant visual depth and memorability.
